title: Find the Peaks
description:
You are given an array mountain.

Your task is to find all peak indices.

A peak is an element that:

is strictly greater than both its neighbors
is not the first or last element

Return a list of indices of all peaks (in any order).
If no element is strictly greater than both neighbors then return [-1]

Example 1
Input: [2,4,4]
Output: [-1]
Explanation: No element is strictly greater than both neighbors

Example 2
Input: [1,4,3,8,5]
Output: [1,3]
Explanation:

index 1 → 4 > 1 and 3
index 3 → 8 > 3 and 5
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
output_format: Print space-separated integers in one line.
